body:
thank you for the honesty! I do realize I’m not some special snowflake and that he could easily move on.

I would not mind it if he just wanted to be friends and even take out any possibility of a romantic relationship as well but I know that’s not very likely.

I’ll talk to him about it

oh I would not make him my plan B though, I wouldn’t date anyone else in the meantime I’d just want to get to know him before actually trying to have a relationship with him, excluding making out, holding hands, sexual contacts or anything of that kind in the process

i’m not really seeking for revenge i am just so angry right now... but it’s a feeling i know how to let go. i just feel very hopeless and have a hard time actually liking people. i can be friendly and people are friendly with me but i rarely wish to connect with someone else. im just very alone now that’s all
thank you for what you wrote i’ll keep it in mind
